tour_type.morning: 🌉 Chain Bridge: Begin with one of Budapest’s most iconic sights and peaceful Danube views. → | 🏰 Buda Castle: Walk or take the funicular up to a hilltop complex full of architecture, courtyards and museums. → | ⛪ Matthias Church: Fairytale roof tiles, Gothic interior and deep historical charm. → | 🏯 Fisherman’s Bastion: White terraces and towers with picture-perfect city views. → | 🍰 Ruszwurm Café: Finish with coffee and traditional cakes in one of the city’s oldest cafés.
tour_type.afternoon: ⛪ St. Stephen’s Basilica: Visit the grand interior and optionally climb to the terrace for panoramic views. → | 🏛️ Andrássy Avenue: Elegant boulevard lined with 19th-century mansions, shops and cafés. → | 🏺 House of Terror Museum: Clear, respectful exhibits about Hungary’s 20th-century history. → | 🍽️ Paprika Vendéglő: Traditional Hungarian dishes with vegetarian options.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Margaret Island: A quiet green escape with fountains, gardens and soft golden-hour light. → OR → ⛴️ Danube Cruise: Watch Parliament, Chain Bridge and Buda Castle glow with reflections on the water.
tour_type.night: 🎨 Szimpla Kert: Quirky, colorful ruin-art spaces for atmosphere only. → | 🌿 Mazel Tov: Urban-garden courtyard with warm lights and cozy design. → | 🎭 Kisüzem: Artsy local vibe. → | ⚠️ Teen note: Descriptions are for atmosphere only; some venues have age restrictions.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🌉 Chain Bridge → 🏰 Buda Castle → ⛪ Matthias Church → 🏯 Fisherman’s Bastion → 🍰 Ruszwurm Café.; Afternoon: ⛪ St. Stephen’s Basilica → 🏛️ Andrássy Avenue → 🏺 House of Terror Museum → 🍽️ Paprika Vendéglő.; Sunset: 🌅 Margaret Island or ⛴️ Danube Cruise.; Night: 🎨 Szimpla Kert → 🌿 Mazel Tov → 🎭 Kisüzem (age restrictions may apply).

tour_type.afternoon: 🏖️ Golden Beach Walk (non-swim areas): Long waterfront paths ideal for slow walks and photos. → | 🎭 City Center Art Corners: Local murals, sculptures and a laid-back urban vibe. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Balaton Specialties: Fresh dishes, soups, pastries and light vegetarian options.

tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🌊 Seaside Promenade: Begin your day with a calm walk along the waterfront — gentle waves, open sea views and fresh morning breeze set the perfect tone. → | 🌺 Millennium Park: Continue through a colorful urban park filled with flowers, sculptures, wide paths and peaceful green corners ideal for relaxing or taking photos. → | ☕ Coastal Café Break: Stop at a nearby seaside café for a warm drink and slow, easy morning energy.; Afternoon: 🏖️ Golden Beach Walk: Head to the city’s long sandy beach — soft sand, shallow waves and bright sunshine create a classic seaside afternoon. Take your time walking along the shore or sitting by the water. → | 🎭 Urban Art Corners: Explore creative murals, sculptures and small street-art spots scattered through the nearby districts — vibrant colors, modern designs and fun, youthful photo moments. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Local Specialties: Enjoy fresh regional dishes such as fish plates, grilled options, soups or light Mediterranean-style meals perfect for a warm day by the sea.; Sunset: 🌅 Pier Lookout: Walk to the pier for one of the best golden-hour viewpoints — wide open sea, glowing sky colors and reflections across the water make for unforgettable photos and peaceful moments. ; Night: 🌙 Dessert Spots and Evening Walk: End the day visiting cozy dessert cafés or ice-cream places, then enjoy a quiet evening stroll along softly lit seaside paths — gentle breeze, calm atmosphere and a perfect way to unwind.
